briefs.rationale: Rewritten in place, keeping the ordinal, combinatorial, descriptive-set-theoretic, proof-theoretic, PCF, reflection, Boolean-algebra and large-cardinal strands with the inner-model, condensation, forcing, symmetric-extension and permutation-model results, and covering the three gained pages at their proved strength: Baire category calibrated to choice, with complete-metric Baire exactly DC, compact-Hausdorff Baire exactly DMC, Urysohn's lemma from DMC but not from CC or BPI, and Stone's metrization failing consistently under DC and BPI; the normal Moore space conjecture proved under PMEA, refuted by V=L, its consistency strength sandwiched between an inner-model measurable cardinal and a strongly compact cardinal; and Shelah's ZF+DC Baire-property model, equiconsistent with ZFC, against universal measurability at an inaccessible.

Rewritten in place, keeping the normed-space and completeness spine (completion, quotients, finite-dimensional equivalence, Riesz's lemma, Baire category under DC, AC_omega uniform boundedness), Fourier analysis and tempered distributions, Hahn--Banach separation and norming, duality with the weak and weak-star topologies, locally convex spaces, Banach--Alaoglu, Goldstine, Krein--Milman, reflexivity, Eberlein--Smulian and James, Schauder bases, bounded approximation, and Bochner integration with the Radon--Nikodym property, and covering the eleven gained pages: Hilbert-space geometry with orthogonal projection and Riesz representation; orthonormal bases, Parseval and Fourier series; compact operators, Riesz--Schauder theory and the Fredholm index; Banach algebras, spectra and holomorphic functional calculus; Gelfand theory for commutative C*-algebras; the continuous, Borel, spectral-measure and unbounded calculi; the compact self-adjoint spectral theorem with Hilbert--Schmidt kernels and trace-class operators; Frechet calculus on Banach manifolds; and Stone's theorem for unitary groups.
